name: zscaler
description: Manage the Zscaler cloud security platform including ZPA (private access), ZIA (internet access), ZDX (digital experience), ZCC (client connector), EASM (attack surface management), and Z-Insights (security analytics). Includes guided skills for application onboarding, policy audits, incident investigation, and cross-product troubleshooting.

rules.name: cross-service-overlap
rules.description: Zscaler APIs have intentional cross-service data overlap. Disabling a service does not remove overlapping tools from other services.

rules.name: write-operation-safety
rules.description: Write operations are disabled by default and require explicit enablement. Delete operations use HMAC confirmation tokens.

rules.name: zdx-read-only
rules.description: ZDX is a read-only monitoring service. The since parameter is in hours, not timestamps.

rules.name: zia-activation-required
rules.description: ZIA requires explicit activation after any create, update, or delete operation. Forgetting this is the number one source of issues.

rules.name: zms-graphql-conventions
rules.description: ZMS uses GraphQL and is read-only. Every query requires ZSCALER_CUSTOMER_ID and uses specific pagination patterns.

rules.name: zpa-dependency-chain
rules.description: ZPA application onboarding requires resources to be created in a specific dependency order. Skipping dependencies causes cryptic 400 errors.

rules.name: zscaler-tool-conventions
rules.description: Zscaler MCP tool naming, discovery, and usage conventions for the Zero Trust Exchange.

commands.name: app-health
commands.description: Analyze application health across the organization using ZDX scores and metrics.

commands.name: audit-software
commands.description: Audit software inventory across devices using ZDX data for compliance and vulnerability assessment.

commands.name: audit-ssl
commands.description: Audit ZIA SSL inspection rules -- list rules by action (INSPECT, DO_NOT_INSPECT, DO_NOT_DECRYPT, BLOCK), identify bypasses, and assess risk.

commands.name: check-access
commands.description: Check whether a user or group can access a specific URL via ZIA policies.

commands.name: compare-locations
commands.description: Compare digital experience across locations, departments, or geolocations using ZDX.

commands.name: create-access-rule
commands.description: Create a ZPA access policy rule with v2 conditions for application access control.

commands.name: create-forwarding-rule
commands.description: Create a ZPA client forwarding policy rule to bypass or intercept traffic.

commands.name: create-server-group
commands.description: Create a ZPA server group with required app connector group dependency.

commands.name: create-timeout-rule
commands.description: Create a ZPA timeout policy rule for session re-authentication and idle timeout.

commands.name: diagnose-deeptrace
commands.description: Run a ZDX deep trace diagnostics session — start, analyze, or clean up deep traces for a user's device.

commands.name: investigate-alerts
commands.description: Investigate active and historical ZDX alerts to understand scope, root cause, and impact.

commands.name: investigate-incident
commands.description: Investigate security incidents using Z-Insights analytics -- threats, firewall actions, shadow IT, and web traffic.

commands.name: investigate-sandbox
commands.description: Investigate ZIA Sandbox file analysis -- check sandbox reports, quota, SSL prerequisite, and diagnose file block/quarantine issues.

commands.name: investigate-url
commands.description: Investigate where a URL or URL category is referenced across ZIA policy rules.

commands.name: onboard-app
commands.description: End-to-end onboarding of a new application in ZPA with full dependency chain.

commands.name: onboard-location
commands.description: End-to-end onboarding of a new ZIA location with traffic forwarding dependencies.

commands.name: review-attack-surface
commands.description: Review external attack surface using Zscaler EASM findings, exposed services, and lookalike domains.

commands.name: troubleshoot-connector
commands.description: Troubleshoot ZPA App Connector issues -- enrollment, connectivity, upgrades, and resource utilization.

commands.name: troubleshoot-experience
commands.description: Troubleshoot a user's digital experience using ZDX scores, metrics, and network path data.

commands.name: troubleshoot-user
commands.description: Cross-product troubleshooting of user connectivity across ZCC, ZDX, ZPA, and ZIA.
